message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total number of employees, using headcount data from annual 10-K filings.", "rationale": "Rapid expansion in workforce may signal aggressive growth strategies or overinvestment; lower growth could reflect discipline or maturity.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly inventory levels over the past three years, divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "High inventory volatility might indicate demand uncertainty or operational inefficiency, which could be penalized by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Operating Lease Intensity", "construction": "Total annual operating lease expense divided by total assets, from annual financial statements.", "rationale": "Firms with high off-balance-sheet leverage may be riskier than they appear, potentially offering higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Long-Term Debt Repayment Ratio", "construction": "Ratio of principal repayments of long-term debt in the past year to total long-term debt outstanding.", "rationale": "Firms aggressively paying down debt may be signaling robust cash flows and prudent management, potentially yielding higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "SG&A Efficiency Ratio", "construction": "One minus the ratio of selling, general, and administrative expenses to gross profit, using annual data.", "rationale": "A higher ratio indicates better cost control relative to gross profit, possibly leading to superior profitability and returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Count Change", "construction": "Annual percentage change in the number of patents granted to the company (using USPTO data matched by firm name or CUSIP).", "rationale": "Increasing patent activity may signal innovation and future growth potential.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Non-Operating Income Ratio", "construction": "Non-operating income (such as from investments or asset sales) less non-operating expenses, divided by total income before extraordinary items, using annual income statements.", "rationale": "Firms that rely less on non-operating income may have more sustainable core earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Foreign Sales Proportion", "construction": "Total foreign sales divided by total sales, as reported in segment disclosures in 10-K filings.", "rationale": "Greater international exposure may diversify revenue sources and offer growth opportunities, especially for US investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Receivables Turnover Change", "construction": "Year-over-year change in receivables turnover ratio (annual credit sales divided by average accounts receivable).", "rationale": "Improvement in receivables turnover suggests better cash collection and working capital management.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "Number of years since current CEO assumed office, using executive disclosures in proxy statements (DEF 14A).", "rationale": "Very short tenures may indicate instability; very long tenures could signal entrenchment. Recent appointments may involve significant strategic change and risk.", "higher_returns_for": "medium values of the measure"}]}
